Pad Live a 4 pages de 16 pads, A à D : t: Pad Live has 4 pages of 16 pads, A to D: touch a letter to change page. “Pack” fills the page shown with the sounds of a style; “Cancel” puts it back as before. The “Challenge” star starts a challenge.
Chaque ligne est une brique (A, B, C…),: Each row is a block (A, B, C…), each column a track. Touch a cell to launch it, the letter to launch the whole row, ■ to stop.
La colonne Remix joue un passage de la c: The Remix column plays a passage of the song: long-press one of its cells to choose it.
Un réglage tout prêt (Sous l'eau, Lo-Fi: A ready-made setting (Underwater, Lo-Fi Tape, Huge cathedral…): it sets the Colour, Dirt, Motion and Space knobs at once, and some also add effects to the list.
Place : touche un coup, puis règle le cu: Pan: tap a hit, then move the “Pan of hit” slider just below to send it left or right (on top of the pad's pan).
Hauteur : touche un coup, puis règle le: Pitch: tap a hit, then move the “Pitch of hit” slider just below to raise or lower it (in semitones).
Une case de la grille : un seizième de m: One square of the grid: a sixteenth of a bar. Turning a step on plays the sound at that moment. Hits: on or off. Rolls: several quick hits in the square. Pan: left or right. Pitch (imported sounds): higher or lower. Velocity: louder or softer.
One square of the grid: a sixteenth of a bar. Tap a square to put a hit in it, tap it again to remove it; slide your finger to put several. Long-press a hit: its strength and its rolls.
Ce chapitre n'est pas fini : il reste l': This chapter is not finished: step %d is left. Touch “Chapters” to go back to it.
Pas dans l'ordre : le morceau commence p: Not in order: the song starts with “%s”.
Pas dans l'ordre : après « %1$s » vient: Not in order: after “%1$s” comes “%2$s”. A part's ⋮ menu removes it, or inserts another one after it.
This step is not done yet.
Touche encore « Suivant » pour la passer: Touch “Next” again to skip it anyway.
Partie « %s » créée : tout le Groove y j: Part “%s” made: the whole Groove plays in it.
Partie « %1$s » créée (copie du Groove): Part “%1$s” made (a copy of the Groove): without %2$s.
Sa basse est à toi d'écrire : les notes: Its bass is yours to write: the dotted notes.
Sa caisse claire accélère mesure après m: Its snare speeds up bar after bar, and its last beat goes quiet.
Son pad « %s » accélère mesure après mes: Its pad “%s” speeds up bar after bar, and its last beat goes quiet.
